description.value: This Starbucks sits along the 88 Avenue corridor in BC's Lower Mainland Fraser Valley, a well-traveled route for touring cyclists moving between communities. As a full-service Starbucks location, it offers espresso drinks, teas, and a range of packaged and prepared food items in a consistent sit-down environment. Cyclists will find it a predictable and accessible mid-ride stop in an otherwise suburban stretch.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (5 spaces, covered) at 94m. Total: 5 spaces.

The generic corporate website limits amenity verification, but the business is clearly operational and cyclist-relevant.
